description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Earth 2 with Stacking] if entry damage was Fire/Earth, [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Rain]

description.name: Zenith Mode: Rain
description.text: Increases [Fire/Earth Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire or Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Rain after using three Fire or Earth abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Spirit Attack: Rain
description.text: Grants [Buff Fire 30% (15s)] and [Buff Earth 30% (15s)] to all allies

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Earth 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
